No one enters Paradise without trials like those before, who were shaken by poverty and hardship until they asked when Allah's help would come, and it is near.
Allah will separate the evil from the good among believers; He does not reveal the unseen to them but chooses messengers, so believe in Him and His messengers.
Believers will be tested in possessions and selves and hear much abuse from those given the Scripture and polytheists; patience and fearing Allah show determination.
Allah made people successors on earth and raised some above others in rank to test them through what He gave; He is swift in penalty, yet Forgiving and Merciful.
Fear a trial that will not strike only the wrongdoers among you, and know that Allah is severe in penalty.
Believers will not be left until Allah makes evident who strives and takes no intimates besides Allah, His Messenger and the believers.
If Allah hastened the evil people invoke as He hastens good, their term would end; man calls on Him in affliction, then, relieved, carries on as if he never called.
Given mercy after adversity, people plot against Allah's verses; caught by a storm at sea they pray to Him sincerely, then commit injustice on earth once He saves them.
Man despairs and is ungrateful when mercy is withdrawn and boastful when favor follows hardship, except those who are patient and do righteous deeds, who have forgiveness and great reward.
Your Lord encompasses the people; the vision shown to the Prophet and the accursed tree in the Quran were made a trial, and warnings only increase their transgression.
Some worship Allah on an edge, content when good touches them but turning away when trial strikes, and so lose both this world and the Hereafter.
People who say they believe will be tried as those before them were, so Allah makes evident the truthful and the liars, and evildoers cannot outrun Him.
Man calls on Allah in hardship but credits favor to his own knowledge, though it is a trial; earlier people said the same and suffered what they earned.
Whatever disaster strikes you is for what your hands earned, though Allah pardons much; you cannot escape Him on earth or find any protector besides Him.
Allah will test the believers until He makes evident those who strive and are patient.
Every disaster is in a register before it happens, so people neither despair over loss nor exult over gain; Allah does not like the boastful who are stingy.
